contentOrigin: Open thematic curriculum of 30 units × 20 common English headwords, with original Uzbek translations, IPA pronunciations, and simple original example sentences authored for this starter package. Simple translate-the-word exercises and short original reading passages are included where available; the remaining exercise and reading slots are placeholders to extend further.

words.example: I want to be a teacher.

words.exampleUz: Biz tushlikni soat o'n ikkida yeymiz.

reading.title: A Day at School
reading.text: Every morning I go to school by bus. I like my teacher. In the class I read, write and listen. At lunch time my friends and I eat together. In the afternoon we play in the garden. After school I come home and do my homework.
reading.question: What does the writer do in the afternoon at school?

reading.title: My Family
reading.text: I have a big family. My father is a doctor. My mother is a teacher. I have one brother and one sister. We live in a nice house. We love each other. On Sunday we eat lunch together.
reading.question: How many brothers and sisters does the writer have?

words.example: He wore a tie around his neck.

reading.title: A Healthy Body
reading.text: Our body has many parts. We see with our eyes. We hear with our ears. We walk with our legs. We hold things with our hands. A strong heart helps us live well. We must take care of our body every day.
reading.question: What do we use to walk?
